name: vLLM-TorchTPU Docker guide
description: Container images and build targets for TPU inference; distinguish runtime images from CI-only images.

assertions.assertion: vLLM-TorchTPU Docker guide provides official guidance on Container images and build targets for TPU inference; distinguish runtime images from CI-only images.
TorchTPU is the native PyTorch runtime replacing the deprecated PyTorch/XLA backend for TPU workloads.
vLLM-TorchTPU is the out-of-tree PyTorch-native serving backend for vLLM on TPUs, distinct from the JAX-native vllm-tpu backend.
